name: Arcane Scourge
body:
School evocation; Level magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 feet + 10 ft./level)
Area 60-foot cube
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level
Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You tap into the latent arcane energies in an area and enhance them to your benefit. You cause an area within range to become animated with arcane energies. Each effect has an amount of space within the area that can be affected and a space can only have one effect. SR is checked per effect.

Arcane Vortex: At the beginning of your turn, any creature within 5 feet of the vortex area takes 3d6 force damage. A successful Fortitude save halves this damage. You may place up to 2, 5-foot cubes of this effect within the area.

Air of Slumber: Any creature beginning their turn in or passing through an area with this effect must make a Will save or be affected as per the sleep spell except there is no HD limit. You may place up to 4, 5-foot cubes of this effect within the area.

Dilated Time: Any area within the affected area that is affected by this time dilation is treated as difficult terrain for enemies, or increase the speed of yourself or allies by 5 feet while passing through the area. You may place up to 8, 5-foot cubes of this effect within the area.

Storm Front: Any creature beginning their turn in or passing through an area with this effect takes 3d4 electricity damage. A successful Reflex save halves this damage. Additionally, as a swift action, you may launch a bolt of lighting at a target within 10 feet of one of these areas. If you succeed on a ranged touch attack, the target takes 3d4 electricity damage. You may place up to 2 5-foot cubes of this effect.
